name: 60645 · Chicago, IL
findings: ZIP 60645 (Chicago) has 215 nonprofit organizations. 95 of them (44%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 75 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (37% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 60645 (Chicago) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
